name: Altstadt Genusshotel Auracher Löchl
beschreibung: The Altstadt Genusshotel Auracher Löchl is set in a historic building in Kufstein's old town. The pedestrian zone surrounding the hotel ensures short walking distances to the fortress and the Inn River. The rooms are individually styled and equipped with modern comforts. The restaurant focuses on Tyrolean specialities prepared with regional ingredients. A wellness area with a sauna and steam bath is at the disposal of guests. The term Genusshotel highlights the property's culinary dedication. Guests can expect accommodation that seamlessly combines a central setting with fine gastronomy.
